ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(select * from sysobjects where name='ProdPlanowanieTowaruInfo' and type='P') drop procedure CDN.ProdPlanowanieTowaruInfo

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.ProdPlanowanieTowaruInfo @Zlecenie int, @Technologia int, @PlanowacOd int, @TechnologiaZasob int, @PZEId int, @MetodaPlanowania int AS BEGIN --zapytanie zwracające informację jaką ilość danego produktu potrzebujemy wyprodukować
select PTZ_Kod, SUM(PZE_Ilosc) Ilosc from ( select PZE_PlanowacOd, SUM(PZE_Ilosc) - ISNULL(SUM(PLKIlosc),0) PZE_Ilosc,PZE_PTZId FROM (SELECT PZE_Id PZEId,ISNULL(SUM(PLK_Ilosc),0) PLKIlosc,cdn.ProdPZEDomyslnyPTZ(PZE_Id) PZE_PTZId from CDN.ProdZlecElem LEFT JOIN CDN.ProdLinki ON PLK_PZEId = PZE_Id GROUP BY PZE_Id) Elementy JOIN CDN.ProdZlecElem ON PZE_Id = PZEId WHERE PZE_Zlecenie = @Zlecenie and PZE_Technologia = @Technologia and PZE_PlanowacOd = @PlanowacOd AND (@PZEId = 0 OR PZE_Id = @PZEId) AND PZE_PTZId = @TechnologiaZasob group by PZE_PlanowacOd, PZE_PTZId ) PTZ inner join CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby on PTZ_Id = @TechnologiaZasob group by PTZ_Kod
/*select PTZ_Kod, PZE_Ilosc Ilosc from ( select PZE_PlanowacOd, sum(PZE_Ilosc) PZE_Ilosc from ( select PZE_PlanowacOd, PZE_Ilosc, coalesce( max(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha and PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=0 AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when (PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=1 or PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha='<Numer seryjny>') AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha and PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=0 AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end ), MAX(case when PTZ1.PTZ_KlasaCechy=PZE_KlasaCechy and PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha=PZE_Cecha AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end), MAX(case when (PTZ1.PTZ_EdycjaCechy=1 or PTZ1.PTZ_Cecha='<Numer seryjny>') AND ISNULL(PTZ2.PTZ_Id,0) <> 0 then PTZ1.PTZ_Id else null end)) PZE_PTZId from ( select PZE_TwrTyp, PZE_TwrNumer, PZE_KlasaCechy, PZE_Cecha, PZE_PlanowacOd, PZE_Technologia, SUM(PZE_Ilosc) - ISNULL(SUM(PLK_Ilosc),0) PZE_Ilosc from CDN.ProdZlecElem LEFT JOIN CDN.ProdLinki ON PLK_PZEId = PZE_Id where PZE_Zlecenie = @Zlecenie and PZE_Technologia = @Technologia and PZE_PlanowacOd = @PlanowacOd group by PZE_TwrTyp, PZE_TwrNumer, PZE_KlasaCechy, PZE_Cecha, PZE_PlanowacOd, PZE_Technologia ) Elem left outer join CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_Technologia=PZE_Technologia left outer join CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby PTZ1 on PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc=PTC_Id and PTZ_TwrTyp=PZE_TwrTyp and PTZ_TwrNumer=PZE_TwrNumer and PTZ_TypZasobu=0 AND CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(PTZ1.PTZ_Ilosc,PTZ1.PTZ_IloscAtr,14340,PTC_Technologia,0,0) > 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby PTZ2 ON PTZ1.PTZ_Id = PTZ2.PTZ_TechnologiaZasob and PTC_Technologia = (SELECT PTC_Technologia FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci WHERE PTC_Id = PTZ2.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc) group by PZE_PlanowacOd, PZE_Ilosc, PTZ1.PTZ_Id ) Zas where PZE_PTZId = @TechnologiaZasob group by PZE_PlanowacOd ) PTZ inner join CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby on PTZ_Id = @TechnologiaZasob --left outer join CDN.ProdProcesy on PPC_Zlecenie = @Zlecenie -- and (PPC_PlanowacOd=PZE_PlanowacOd or (PPC_PlanowacOd=0 and PZE_PlanowacOd<0)) --left outer join CDN.ProdCzynnosci on*/
--zapytanie zwracające informacje istniejącym procesie dotyczącym tego samego produktu, jeśli istnieje planowanie zwiększy ilość na istniejącym planowaniu select PPC_Id, PTC_Id, PPC_Ilosc, PTE_Ilosc, PTC_Ilosc, PTC_IloscMax, PTZ_Ilosc, sum(PCZ_Ilosc) PCZ_Ilosc, sum(Realizacje) Realizacje, min(case when Realizacje>0 then 2147483647 else PCZ_Id end) Czynnosc from ( select PPC_Id, PTC_Id, PPC_Ilosc, PTE_Ilosc, CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(PTC_Ilosc,PTC_IloscAtr,14340,PTE_Id,-PZL_DataWystawienia,PPC_Id) PTC_Ilosc, CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(PTC_IloscMax,PTC_IloscMaxAtr,14340,PTE_Id,-PZL_DataWystawienia,PPC_Id) PTC_IloscMax, CDN.Prod_WartoscAtr(PTZ_Ilosc,PTZ_IloscAtr,14340,PTE_Id,-PZL_DataWystawienia,PPC_Id) PTZ_Ilosc, isnull(C.PCZ_Ilosc,0) PCZ_Ilosc, count(R.PCZ_Id) Realizacje, isnull(C.PCZ_Id,0) PCZ_Id from CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby inner join CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_Id=PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc inner join CDN.ProdTechnologia on PTE_Id=PTC_Technologia inner join CDN.ProdZlecenia on PZL_Id = @Zlecenie inner join CDN.ProdProcesy on PPC_Zlecenie=PZL_Id and PPC_Technologia=PTE_Id and (PPC_PlanowacOd in (@PlanowacOd, case when @PlanowacOd < 0 then 0 else @PlanowacOd end)) --w kodzie Clarionowym było: (PPC_PlanowacOd=' & lPlanowacOd & choose(lPlanowacOd<0,' or PPC_PlanowacOd=0','') & ') ' left outer join CDN.ProdCzynnosci C on PCZ_Proces=PPC_Id and PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc=PTC_Id and PCZ_Realizuje=0 left outer join CDN.ProdCzynnosci R on R.PCZ_Realizuje=C.PCZ_Id where PTZ_Id= @TechnologiaZasob group by PTZ_Id, PTZ_Ilosc, PTZ_IloscAtr, PTC_Id, PTC_Ilosc, PTC_IloscAtr, PTC_IloscMax, PTC_IloscMaxAtr, PTE_Id, PTE_Ilosc, PZL_DataWystawienia, PPC_Id, PPC_Ilosc, C.PCZ_Id, C.PCZ_Ilosc ) C where PTZ_Ilosc>0 group by PTZ_Ilosc, PTC_Id, PTC_Ilosc, PTC_IloscMax, PTE_Ilosc, PPC_Id, PPC_Ilosc having PTC_IloscMax=0 or PTC_IloscMax*PPC_Ilosc/PTE_Ilosc>sum(PCZ_Ilosc) or sum(Realizacje)=0 order by Realizacje desc, Czynnosc desc END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ProdPlanowanieTowaruInfo TO CDNRaport
